metadata.description: UI design skills and plugins, built from researched patterns with concrete tokens.

plugins.name: dashboard-ui
plugins.description: Dashboard UI design: 91 researched patterns (hierarchy, data display, charts, colour, components, motion, progressive UI) plus a review rubric and starter tokens.

plugins.name: marketing-ui
plugins.description: Landing pages, marketing sites and product pages: 19 researched patterns (narrative, hero, proof, features and bento, pricing, FAQ, footer, type and art direction, generated-default tells, motion, LCP, fonts, SEO) plus a review rubric and a token layer.

plugins.name: mobile-ui
plugins.description: Mobile web, responsive apps and PWAs: 20 researched patterns (thumb reach, 44pt/48dp/24px targets, safe areas, dvh/svh and the keyboard, bottom nav, sheets and detents, gestures, mobile forms, lists and tables, Dynamic Type, dark mode, haptics, PWA install and offline, low-end performance, foldables) with Apple HIG and Material 3 conventions, plus a review rubric and mobile tokens.

plugins.name: motion-ui
plugins.description: Product-UI motion and gesture: 20 researched patterns (purpose and frequency, durations and easing, springs mapped across CSS, Motion, React Spring, SwiftUI and Material 3, drag, momentum, sheets, enter/exit, View Transitions, scroll-driven animation, performance, reduced motion) plus a frame-based review rubric and motion tokens.

plugins.name: forms-ui
plugins.description: Web form design: 20 researched patterns (layout, labels, input types and autofill, choice controls, money/date/phone/file inputs, validation and errors, submission, multi-step flows, passkeys) plus an anti-pattern catalogue, a review rubric and starter form styles.

plugins.name: design-system
plugins.description: Set up and keep a coherent design system in your project: 13 researched patterns (token architecture and versioning, DTCG, theming and multi-brand, dark mode, type, spacing and radius scales, Tailwind v4/shadcn/CSS Modules/MUI mappings, evidence-based domain profiles, drift detection), a verified OKLCH theme generator (WCAG 2 + APCA, light/dark/high contrast) and a DESIGN.md decision record.

plugins.name: ai-ui
plugins.description: UI for AI features: 20 researched patterns (AI identity and expectations, uncertainty without crying wolf, latency budgets, privacy and consent, accessible generated content, chat layout, streaming and stop, thinking and agent steps, markdown and code, citations, edit/regenerate/branching, IME-safe prompt input, suggestions, errors/refusals/rate limits, feedback, ghost text and diffs, agent approval and audit, WebMCP) plus an anti-pattern catalogue, a review rubric and AI-UI tokens.

plugins.name: i18n-rtl
plugins.description: Internationalisation and right-to-left UI with Hebrew and Arabic as first-class cases: 19 researched patterns (logical properties, what mirrors and what must not, dir and dir=auto, bidi isolation of mixed Hebrew/English/number text, digits, minus sign and ₪ position, Hebrew and Hijri calendars and week start, directional icons, Hebrew and Arabic typography, RTL forms, tables and charts, :dir() and Tailwind rtl:, ICU plurals with Hebrew dual forms and gender, text expansion, locale negotiation without flags, pseudo-localisation and a Playwright RTL recipe) plus a Hebrew-site teardown with IS 5568, an anti-pattern catalogue, a review rubric and logical-property utilities.

plugins.name: accessibility
plugins.description: Build and audit any UI to WCAG 2.2 AA: 20 researched patterns (a success-criteria map by builder task, landmarks and headings, names and roles, keyboard and focus not obscured, 24px targets and drag alternatives, consistent help, redundant entry and accessible authentication, contrast, motion, reflow and text spacing, forced colours, ARIA and APG patterns, live regions, VoiceOver/NVDA/TalkBack cheat-sheets, a manual test plan, axe-core with Playwright and its coverage limit, accessibility statements, EAA, ADA Title II, Section 508, EN 301 549 and Israel IS 5568) plus an anti-pattern catalogue, an audit rubric with report template and accessibility utilities.

plugins.name: design-review
plugins.description: Evidence-based UI review: Playwright capture, a deterministic rendered gate (12 detectors), a static UI lint (10 rules), a fresh-eye reviewer brief and a handover record.

plugins.name: components-ui
plugins.description: Interactive component behaviour: reuse-first selection ladder, state matrix and async model, dialogs, popovers and menus, tooltips, toasts, drag and drop, virtualised lists, plus anti-patterns and a review rubric.
